description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: rounded overlapping ropes and lobes formed as one continuous crust. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants.
description.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：圆钝重叠绳纹与叶瓣连成连续熔岩壳。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。

sources.title: Lava Flows

reconstruction_notes.en: Geological-form artistic concept: one closed continuous crust mesh, with rounded bowed folds following a common flow direction and a subordinate overlapping tongue. Original cropped patch, cool matte basalt palette and nominal 0.9 m scale; not a precise site, eruption stage, cooling history or flow-rate reconstruction. No image textures, detached ropes, pillow stack or seamless-tiling claim.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 地质形态艺术概念：单一封闭连续壳体，以顺共同流向弯曲的圆润褶皱与次级舌状流前缘表现层次。原创截取片段，冷灰哑光玄武岩色系，0.9米为名义艺术尺度；不主张精确地点、喷发阶段、冷却历史或流速。不使用图像贴图，不堆放独立绳条或枕状块，不宣称无缝平铺。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
